question: In a certain code language, 'BIRTHDAY' is written as 'ADHTRIBY' and 'CONGRESS' is written as 'SERGNOCS'. How will 'DIVISION' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'BIRTHDAY' is written as 'ADHTRIBY'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00087d845afdf698823cfa5e540cc1e9c27a324c921d3b067768cba1336e6d22.png] 

And,

'CONGRESS' is written as 'SERGNOCS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/131cb5a202530e9a34267a31ff78b57f6c8647940c13a534823d4bd5fde6880e.png] 

Similarly,

'DIVISION' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68c1bb616c05d97d2c44e0659dbdebd459a25b0e94e23efa71a5c3cfcb4fccbe.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
